title: Creamy Garlic {p} with {v}
steps: Season the {p} with salt, pepper and the {spice}. Sear in a hot oiled skillet until golden and {doneness}, then move to a plate.
Cook the {s} until tender, and keep a little of its water.
Lower the heat and cook the {v} in the same pan for a minute. Pour in a splash of broth and the {sauce}, and simmer until lightly thickened.
Return the {p} and toss in the {s}, loosening with the cooking water if needed. Serve right away.
tip: Use milk or half-and-half instead of cream, and add extra spinach.
